name: 311-accelerator-factory
description: Factory skills for the 311 Accelerator: turn a city's 311 / citizen service request requirements into a tailored implementation on Public Sector Solutions — residents' reports as Public Complaints, the work as Cases in department queues, a ready-made branded resident portal with Customer Community Login, crews on the Salesforce mobile app — without forking the sm311 package. Checks the org, scopes the footprint, detects the licences a scope triggers, clones request types from the library, generates and deploys the city layer and portal from one config file, gates the build, and adds deltas to a live city.
